contea di ritrovamento: Hampshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

rTwo early-medieval silver sceats found close together, dating to 675-750. 1) BM type 27b, die axis = 12, weight 1.12g, diameter 12.9mm. Obverse: Diademed head right, crescent ear, beaded serpent circle. Reverse: Bird on cross within serpent circle, annulet to either side, unintelligible inscription around [...]OOOT[...]. 2) BM type Primary Series A with legend TIC, die axis = 9, weight 1.13g,…
